name: Create Animal Classification Chart
description:
Create a 3-page interactive flipchart for a 6th-grade science lesson on Animal Classification.

Your task is to build a structured presentation with the following pages:

**Page 1 — Introduction**
- Add the title "Animal Classification"
- Add introductory text mentioning the two main groups: "Vertebrates" and "Invertebrates"

**Page 2 — Classification Tree Diagram**
- Create a visual hierarchy diagram using the Shape tool (rectangles) and Text tool.
- The tree must start with "Animals" at the top.
- Branch into "Vertebrates" and "Invertebrates".
- Under Vertebrates, list at least 4 classes (Fish, Amphibians, Reptiles, Birds, Mammals).
- Under Invertebrates, list at least 2 classes (Insects, Arachnids, Mollusks).
- Use at least 8 rectangle shapes to box these categories.

**Page 3 — Sort the Animals Activity**
- Add the title "Sort the Animals"
- List at least 6 of the following animals for students to categorize: Eagle, Salmon, Frog, Spider, Snail, Cobra, Butterfly, Dolphin, Beetle, Turtle.

Save the completed flipchart to `/home/ga/Documents/Flipcharts/animal_classification.flipchart`.
